map.某值低于总体中多少比例的数据。: The proportion of data in the group that falls below a given value.
map.📖 查看「百分等级计算器使用指南」: 📖 View the "Percentile Rank Calculator User Guide"
map.某分数在群体中的相对位置。: Relative position of a score within a group.
map.成绩、身高的\"超过百分之多少\"。: "What percentage am I above" for exam scores and heights.
map.30 人中 12 人低于 80、3 人等于 80：PR=(12+0.5×3)/3: Among 30 people, 12 score below 80 and 3 equal 80: PR=(12+0.5×3)/30×100=(13.5)/30×100=45, i.e. ahead of roughly 45% of the group (the 45th percentile).
map.百分位 P_k 是\"第 k% 的人低于此值\"的分数；百分等级是某分数对应的: The percentile P_k is the score below which k% of people fall; the percentile rank is the k matching a given score, so the two are inverse functions.
map.把等于自身的半个人计入排名，避免把自身算作\"低于\"，是常用经验修正。: It counts half of the tied cases, avoiding treating one's own score as below itself; a standard empirical correction.
